bio: In the evenings, this delightful little restaurant in a lively street (Bahnhofstrasse) promises warm hospitality in a down-to-earth and friendly atmosphere. Flavoursome modern dishes are served in a set menu format – choose between a three- and five-course version, with pescetarian alternatives available in both cases. The top-notch ingredients are locally sourced. The wine list exclusively features Valais labels, and the selection is impressive....
